criteria.requirement: Expose loguru.LazyValue(zero_argument_callable) and integrate event-local wrappers into actual Logger argument formatting. Mix ordinary and wrapped positional/keyword values; only actually accessed placeholders evaluate, preserving standard format specs,!s,!r,attribute/index access and color formatting. Repeated references/aliases and multiple sinks share one result per event, but later events compute anew; level/activation short-circuit stays before evaluation. Captured kwargs publish evaluated values or an explicit <unevaluated LazyValue> marker so serialize=True never forces unused computation. Keep opt(lazy=True) old all-callable semantics and propagate computation errors. Top-level argument wrappers are supported; do not silently recurse into arbitrary business containers.
